name: @argszero/dsh-command-interceptor
description: One interception point for every typed slash command. The commands service emits only `commands/change` and runs `execute()` with no waterfall around it, so a plugin that must inspect, defer, answer or replace a typed command can only replace `commands.execute` — and two plugins replacing one method drop each other's wrapper. This plugin takes that one wrapper itself and fans it out to a registry: N plugins register interceptors, the first non-`next` outcome wins, and every wrapper is restored when the plugin unloads. Answers discussion #14014.
